description: Literal ASA/NA whole-word absorption and synchronous JK state feedback with actual editable equations.

trajectories.description: Latch: drive sets selected bits, then the equation retains its own result.
Toggle: J=K=y and constant drive on every present bit produce an exact period-two orbit.
A boundary hit absorbs the entire ASA/NA output, preserving old q under the resulting JK hold.
High bit and all-ones literal: 1 means 0xffffffff in a word equation.
Both J and K read old q, with independent nontrivial Boolean expressions.
Empty present domain has exactly one state.
